اقترعا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَعَا (iqtaraʕā) /iq.ta.ra.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اُقْتُرِعَا (uqturiʕā) /uq.tu.ri.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اِقْتَرِعَا (iqtariʕā) /iq.ta.ri.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
